paite: Mithilhihtheitak tate aw, TOUPA kiang ah pia unla, TOUPA kiang ah thupina leh hatna pia un.
heading: David La / Huihpi Lak A TOUPA AW

paite: TOUPA kiang ah amin thupina pia unla; siangthou kilawmna silh in TOUPA bia un.
TOUPA aw tui tungte ah aging a; thupina Pathian ahong ging doldol a, TOUPA mah tui tampi tung ah aging hi.
TOUPA aw thilhihtheitak ahi a; TOUPA aw thupitak ahi.
TOUPA aw in sidar singte ahihtan a; ahi, TOUPA'N Lebanon tang a sidar singte ahihtan lemlum zel hi.
Bawngnou bang in amaute adiangsak a; Lebanon leh Sirion tangte gam bawngtalnou bang mai in.
TOUPA aw in meikuangte aphelh zel.
TOUPA aw in gamdai sing aling a; TOUPA'N Kadesh gamdai alingsak zel hi.
TOUPA aw in zukpite nou aneisak a, gammang singnahte anuaikeu vek hi; atempul ah, "Athupi e!" achi chiat zel uhi.
Tuichim lai in kumpipa in TOUPA atu a, ahi, tangtawn a ding in kumpipa ding in TOUPA atu hi.
TOUPA'N amite kiang ah hatna ape ding a, TOUPA'N amite khamuanna in avualzawl ding hi.
